verdict.rationale: Next.js is a framework rather than a data-holding service, but a buyer could still fairly ask about its privacy posture, such as controls over data it collects or retains, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents data retention or deletion controls. The caching and ISR items (docs-5, docs-18) cover rendering and cache behavior, an adjacent feature that is not user-data retention or deletion and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
